The '''Wilderness champion amulet''' was an amulet worn by champions during the [[Wilderness Wars]] event in 2017. Alongside a unique [[Wilderness cape (Wilderness Wars, Champion)|Wilderness cape]], the champions of each team wore this to identify them amongst their 50 teammates.
